conditions: These are Ghost-clan costs; larger clans pay more. The Bash Lab needs an Oracle and a Tenno Lab built first, so most clans lack it. Join one with the research done and this costs you nothing.
Research sits at Awaiting Funds until the vault is stocked: in a clan that has not done it, you fund all five.

The Detonite Injector is a Chem Lab item: Grineer Invasion reward (3 per completion), rare Grineer storage containers, tier 4 Orb Vallis bounty stages, or crafted in a Chem Lab (10 Detonite Ampule, 1 Control Module, 500 Salvage, 250 Plastids, 15,000 cr, 12h).

disclosures.title: where the research materials come from
disclosures.body: Detonite Ampule is a Grineer resource: Dark Sector survivals on Ceres (Gabii) and Saturn (Piscinas), Earth Cervantes sabotage caches, and 3 per Grineer Invasion reward. Neural Sensors: Themisto (Alad V, 2-4 per kill), a Jupiter survival, or Kuva Fortress survival with a Resourceful Retriever beast. Oxium is slow, so run it with a Resource Booster on Phobos Gulliver or Jupiter Io defense.

disclosures.title: why not build a dojo
disclosures.body: A player who built the Oracle and Bash Lab solo for this one weapon locked up their power and needed rescuing. Research-complete clans are asked about in recruitment and region chat.

conditions: Replication costs credits per piece and per player, even when the clan did the research.
